cross_cutting_mbo_finding.headline: The G19 cum-0 fix worked, and that is exactly why the block leaned. The fix made the blind's chain CONTINUOUS; it cannot make it TRACK REALITY, because the blind is masked from price. A continuous chain built from the blind's own forecast day-moves INTEGRATES the blind's own directional error without bound - and every extension-gated play then reads extension off the wrong side of it. One mechanism produces both halves of G20's error, including the sign inversion on my day.

the_measurement.definition: constructed_cum = running sum of the blind's own guess_day_move_usd (what exit_state_blind() hands the next day). realized_cum = cum_from_anchor_usd from the realized legs (refine-only). divergence = realized - constructed.
the_measurement.what_it_shows: The divergence opens on 0527-0528 (the covering ramp, +1,050 then +3,000) and NEVER recovers; mean |divergence| over days 3-10 is 2,310 = 2.1 x n0_range_20_mean (1,094). By 0529 the blind's constructed chain read cum -830 - a running MINIMUM, polarity DOWN - while the realized chain stood at +2,390, a running MAXIMUM, polarity UP. The constructed chain was 3,220 wrong in level and INVERTED in polarity at the exact seam where extension mattered most.

cross_cutting_mbo_finding.why_this_is_the_block_lean_and_not_a_dow: The blind did not hold a uniform bearish view. Every extension-gated play in the brain reads extension off cum: structure.covering_extension_distribution_flip, structure.friday_exhausted_extreme_giveback, midweek.stretched_extreme_close_giveback, midweek.young_chain_extension_full_band, and the INTRADAY arm of boundary.seam_gap_up_prior_on_worsening_cot. A chain running progressively BELOW reality presents every mid-week day as low-extension with room to fall -> the 4,050 the blind was too LOW across the eight mid-week days. The SAME error presents the one maximally-extended day as un-extended -> the extension-gated FADE never armed, the seam gap prior ran unopposed, and the blind leaned UP by 1,490 across the two Monday-class days. Same cause, opposite signs, allocated by whether the day was extension-gated.
cross_cutting_mbo_finding.my_day_is_the_proof_not_the_exception: 0601 is the ONLY day in the block where the blind's error moved the constructed chain TOWARD reality (divergence 3,220 -> 1,880, a 1,340 narrowing that is exactly my err). Everywhere else the blind's error widened the divergence. An error that widens the gap on eight days and closes it on the two Monday-class days is not two errors; it is one integrator running with a sign that depends on whether the play consulted cum.
cross_cutting_mbo_finding.why_the_fix_made_it_worse_not_better: Pre-fix, restarting at cum 0 each day accidentally re-anchored the chain near neutral every session - the error was intermittent and self-clearing. boundary.chain_label_must_track_realized_cum removed the reset and made the chain continuous, which is correct in a world with realized price and WRONG in a world without one: continuity converts an intermittent bug into a coherent, unbounded drift. This is why the framing's observation holds - the structural fix demonstrably worked and the calls still failed. The fix is not the problem; the fix's PRECONDITION (a chain anchored to something real) was never supplied on the blind side.

the_proposal_general_no_brain_edit_this_.name: chain_staleness_gate (proposed; PROPOSAL only, no brain edit in this run)
the_proposal_general_no_brain_edit_this_.rule: Any play keyed on cum_from_anchor or chain extension must first read a STALENESS term. On the refine side that is |realized_cum - constructed_cum| directly. On the blind side, where realized_cum is masked, the only honest substitute is a bound: the constructed chain is trustworthy for at most k sessions after the last day whose realized move is known, and beyond that every extension-gated play must widen its band or stand down rather than assert a rung.
the_proposal_general_no_brain_edit_this_.threshold_candidate: stand the extension gate down when the staleness term exceeds ~1 x n0_range_20_mean (1,094 here). On 0601 the divergence was 3,220 = 2.9x - three times the stand-down threshold, and the play the blind most needed was the one it was least entitled to run.
the_proposal_general_no_brain_edit_this_.forward_test: compute the divergence table on every future block; the claim is that the blind's per-day |err| correlates with the divergence and that its SIGN flips on extension-gated days. G20 gives 10 points; G21+ is the test.
the_proposal_general_no_brain_edit_this_.why_this_is_not_a_data_fix_banked_as_evi: It is not evidence for any play. It is a GATE on the plays that already exist, and it makes an explicit prediction about the blind's error structure that can falsify it.

overridden.why: Not a rejection of A's read - a different ruler for the same mechanism, and I owe the reason. A assembles the number from two separately-estimated legs (-690 gap giveback plus -850 extension giveback at 1.0-1.5 sigma). I derive it as a single fraction of a MEASURED state: the flip's day-1 delivery of the standing extension, 29.1% from G19 0520, times +3,080 = -896. Two objections to the two-leg route. First, its second leg is sized on n0_net_sigma_20 = 661, and that sigma is a 20260522 pre-ramp vintage this block has already exceeded at 3.16 sigma - the leg inherits a stale ruler. Second, decomposing into legs invites the double-counting question (does the extension term include the gap or not?) that a single fraction of the total extension does not raise, because the G19 measurement was itself a total day-move. A's -850 remains a good cross-check and it brackets mine from above; the 46-dollar spread is not where the disagreement lives.

overridden.my_call: MECHANISM ACCEPTED, LADDER REJECTED. Right mechanism, wrong home.
overridden.why: A describes real behaviour and the tape confirms it. But it is not a third rung of the seam play - it is structure.covering_extension_distribution_flip firing, an EXISTING play at confidence 0.84 whose trigger ('a multi-session crowded-short covering rally with a running cum_from_anchor'), discriminator ('maximally extended... with the absorption tell ITSELF reversed... big BUY absorbed under falling price = DISTRIBUTION DOWN') and exemplar (G19 0520: blind +200 -> refined -950, actual -1,050) already cover 0601 exactly. Three specific costs to A's framing. (1) It would create a weaker n=1 copy of a mechanism the brain holds at n=3 / 0.84, and split the forward evidence between two plays. (2) It keys the read on gap-relative language ('day-move takes the OPPOSITE sign to the gap') when the actual discriminator is a flow signature. Once the flip fires the gap is not a rung on a ladder at all - it has been DEMOTED to one more component of the standing extension to unwind, which is exactly how I sized it. (3) Operationally it fires LATER: a rung defined relative to the gap cannot be evaluated before the gap exists, i.e. 20:00 at the earliest, whereas the flip play's PRE-WARNING clause was satisfiable on 0527. What I would keep from A's rung work, and would support recording as discriminator/requires notes UNDER covering_extension_distribution_flip rather than as a rung: (c) displacement efficiency far above 1, and (e) no forward driver into the session - neither is currently named in that play. A's condition (a), the prior Friday's final phase net-flat-or-reversed under FULL participation, belongs in daytype.friday_exit_decomposition and the handoff, which is where A's own bridge says it belongs.

overridden.item: A's verdict that 'your miss was the rung, not the arithmetic'
overridden.my_call: OVERRIDDEN. The miss was failing to run incumbent gates, not failing to have a rung.
overridden.why: This matters for the merge, because 'the miss was the rung' implies the brain lacked the fix and should acquire one. It did not lack it. Two incumbent Monday plays forbid the exact move the blind made, on their face and without a single input the blind lacked: monday.catchup_window_tilt_gate ('direction = the inherited D-1 trade tilt, NOT the gap sign') and daytype.monday_weekend_gap R3 ('FADE a Sunday gap that jumped WITH a mature swing to a fresh cum-extreme'). The Sunday half of the D-1 tilt (+278) sat in never-masked tape_conditions; the blind used the stub for nothing. On top of that, covering_extension_distribution_flip's PRE-WARNING kill-clause was satisfied on 0527 and 0528. The honest diagnosis is that the blind applied a GAP prior to a DAY sign in the presence of two rules that forbid it - a failure to consult, not a gap in the ladder. And there is a deeper reason the blind could not have consulted them WELL even if it had tried, which is my cross-cutting finding: its constructed chain read cum -830 / polarity DOWN at that seam against a realized +2,390 / polarity UP, so the extension-gated fade could not arm off the blind's own chain. Fix the chain's anchoring and the incumbent gates fire on their own. Add a rung and you have documented the symptom.

where_I_go_past_A_the_substantive_refine.claim: 0529 ph3 is not distribution day 1. It is the AGGRESSION HANDOVER - the phase in which the passive absorber changes sides. The zero net on maximum volume is not a property of the sellers or the buyers; it is the signature of the crossover itself.
where_I_go_past_A_the_substantive_refine.the_sequence_that_shows_it: Session signed flow: 0527 -4,910, 0528 -1,966, 0529 -2,126 - three sessions of net SELL aggression into a rising or held price, i.e. a passive covering BID absorbing everything thrown at it. Then 0601 +3,796 and 0602 +3,524 - net BUY aggression into a falling price, i.e. a passive distribution OFFER absorbing everything. 0529 ph3, at -59 on 60,930 lots, sits exactly at the sign change. Net aggression passes through zero on the block's largest phase because that is the phase in which the covering bid stepped away and the distributing offer stepped in. Neither E ('nobody sold this low') nor A ('distribution already running') captures that: the volume says somebody was there, and the ZERO says it was the handover and not yet the delivery.
where_I_go_past_A_the_substantive_refine.why_it_changes_my_number_and_not_just_th: Under A's reading Monday is day 2 of a distribution and should be sized as a continuation of something already in progress. Under the hinge reading Monday is DAY 1 - the first session in which one side is unambiguously the aggressor into an absorbing offer - and day 1 is where a distribution delivers. The block confirms it: 0601 session net -1,680, 0602 -70 on a nearly identical +3,524 of buy aggression. Same signature, 24x the price effect on day 1. So the hinge reading is the one that says size the Monday FULL and tell the Tuesday owner it self-limits.
where_I_go_past_A_the_substantive_refine.generality_and_its_limit: Proposed as a general tell (+n): at a covering-to-distribution turn, the crossover phase prints NET FLOW NEAR ZERO ON UNUSUALLY HIGH VOLUME, and it is the LAST phase before the flip rather than the first phase of it. It is checkable anywhere a phase table exists and it is exactly the (volume, net) pair A already proposes reading - I am claiming that the pair's zero-net/high-volume cell is a TURN marker, not merely a 'distribution' label. HONEST LIMIT: n=1 clean instance in this block. The block's later reversal (0602 -> 0603, aggression flipping back to net sell as price rose again) does NOT show the same clean hinge phase, so I do not claim it fires at every turn. Proposal only, no brain edit.

adjudication_of_A_vs_E_on_the_0529_exit.what_this_means_for_the_close_as_a_LEVEL: I side with A: the 3.273 close is WEAK BUT REAL. Weak because nothing defended it - close_off_low_frac 0.01 with low_late TRUE. Real because 60,930 lots transferred to make it, so it does not spring back on its own. E's PROPOSED CONDITION on daytype.friday_exit_close_location_over_flow_shape (that the close-location rule requires the final phase to carry material net flow, and inverts below that) is a good instinct aimed at the wrong quantity - the condition should be on VOLUME, not on net flow. A flowless close on 4,000 lots is an unpriced print that reverts; a flowless close on 60,000 lots is a handover that continues. Recommend the condition be restated on the (volume, net) pair before anyone merges it.

summary.one_line: Direction from the D-1 trade tilt through two incumbent Monday gates the blind owed the day; magnitude from structure.covering_extension_distribution_flip's day-1 delivery fraction (29.1%, measured cross-block on G19 0520) applied to this day's own measured standing extension of +3,080 -> -900. Honest-under by 90; the last 90 is not mine to claim.
summary.the_one_thing_the_merge_should_take: The blind's chain is CONSTRUCTED, not realized, and the G19 continuity fix made that error cumulative instead of self-clearing. On 0601 the constructed cum read -830 / polarity DOWN against a realized +2,390 / polarity UP. Every extension-gated play in the brain read the wrong side of that, which is why the blind ran 4,050 too low on eight mid-week days and 1,490 too high on the two Monday-class days from ONE cause. Gate the extension-keyed plays on chain staleness before adding any new rung to any of them.
summary.disagreement_recorded: A proposes a third rung of boundary.seam_gap_up_prior_on_worsening_cot. I accept the mechanism and reject the placement: it is structure.covering_extension_distribution_flip, already in the brain at 0.84 with a cross-block exemplar. A's (c) and (e) conditions are worth adding to THAT play's discriminator set; A's (a) belongs in the Friday handoff. I also reject A's verdict that my miss was 'the rung' - it was a failure to consult two incumbent gates that forbid taking a day sign from a gap sign.
